query: How do I complain against a government college professor or principal?
reference_answer:
Complaint against a Government College Professor or Principal:
To complain, contact the college administration or the Director of Collegiate Education, Tamil Nadu. You can also file a complaint with the Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Department.
answer: To complain against a government college professor or principal, contact the college's administration office or the relevant department within the university. You can also reach out to the Higher Education Commission (HEC) if the issue concerns policy or regulations. [Document 1]
